plan.optimizer_policy: Inherit all interface weights; start fresh optimizer for explicit new curriculum
plan.sampling: Shuffle within each group then traverse without replacement; every member covered before the next group pass
plan.early_stop: Stop immediately on nonfinite computations or changed protected organism; stop at a 100-step check if development NLL exceeds stage baseline by more than 20%. No automatic extra steps or structural changes.

generation.decoding: Raw greedy; only BOS and PAD masked; no UTF-8 repair or restriction

plan.diagnostics: Previous 18 familiar-fact probes retained for continuity, plus 6 new prompts fixed before training. Full diagnostic and new sealed-test loss only after training; no model selection on them.
plan.limitations: Synthetic teaching fragments with strong templates; all results bounded to measured data; memorizing statements is not stable behavioral values or autobiographical memory alignment.

data.note: New held-out documents; original P17 held-outs not added to training. Templates and isolated words are disclosed priors.
